NewsArticle.Title: Mileth Library
NewsArticle.Content:
Mundane Uistean arises from the quiet hermitage to set up a library in Mileth. It is the path nearest to Glioca's shrine. Come discuss The Arts: History, Literature, Lore, and Philosophy.
When asked, Mundane librarian Uistean replied that knowledge should not be hoarded by Loures, nor should it be static, but that discussion of The Arts should continue daily. He recognized the large increase in Aislings in Mileth, so convinced his kin to help him set up a library. Uistean hopes to create a college of The Arts.
The Library of Loures has also been visible since Deoch 1, on the web: [www.darkages.com/atavism](http://www.darkages.com/atavism) The artwork, music, and other sections could not apply to the Library within Loures Castle.
